name: SiftingIO US Stocks API
description: U.S. stock API with REST snapshots, historical OHLCV, SEC filings and XBRL financials, plus real-time WebSocket prices.
notes: Publicly documented data API for U.S. equity research, charting and backtesting. An ongoing free API-key plan is available with request and connection limits. Official Python, Go and TypeScript clients are maintained by SiftingIO. The hosted data service is not open source.
